tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

This contract shall be extended for another 2 terms(1 year each)based on performance of the contractor with reference to Govt . circular no 1511569/DMA/DEV/OTH/205/2024 Dated 19/10/2024.If the contract extended for next term ,then quoted service charge will remain same,only min. Wage,ESI and PF rates will be revised as per current year rates
The authority reserves right to accept or reject of all tenders without giving any reasons
BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL RELEVANT TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS AS PER CONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT ATTACHED
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.38.42 Lakh
Attach copy of Professional tax registration certificate -PTRC and Professional tax Enrollment certificate -PTEC along with PT paid challans of past 6 months till September 2026
Attach the copy of ISO 10004-2018 Certificate
Attested copy of payment details towards Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund for the past 3 years. FORM D -Rule 3-A
BIDDER SHOULD UPLOAD ALL RELEVANT TECHNICAL DOCUMENTS AS PER CONDITIONS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT ATTACHED

Clearance certificate -NOC taken from the Labour Department stating that no cases or complaints against the contractor. The certificate should be taken within 6 months from the date of the tender published
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 11.6 lakhs Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc
Satisfactorily completed at least one similar works of value not less than Rs. 19.3 lakhs, as prime contractor
Tenderer shall produce attested copies of registration certificates of Labour Department, ESI and PF Department
Work done Certificates for supply of Manpower Service for a minimum period of 1 year in last 5 years-8 Nos/day
